strongestExistingGuideImprovement.proposedHeading: Separate a missing event from a list that has run out of rows
proposedBody: A widget shows a limited set of upcoming appointments. If earlier events fill its rows, a later appointment can be absent even though it is present in the app and eligible for the upcoming list. Changing the widget size may show more rows, but it does not make the widget a complete calendar.

Start your comparison with the nearest future timed appointment in a selected calendar. If that event appears but a later one does not, open the app to inspect the rest of the schedule. If the nearest eligible event is also missing, continue with calendar selection, access and update checks. Do not move or delete appointments just to make a later entry appear.
strongestExistingGuideImprovement.basis: Current source prefixes a sorted snapshot; rendered large list is capped by available space and eleven rows. Existing missing-event guide does not explicitly apply this distinction during diagnosis.
strongestExistingGuideImprovement.boundary: Avoid promising exact freshness, fixed forecast coverage, full-year provider sync or 25 visible events. Native source is not released/runtime proof.
